Game engine architecture for entity slot reuse and cleanup (CG_Shutdown)

dpo_pairs.prompt: How did John Carmack handle server commands during demo playback?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He ensured that commands were not forwarded to the server when the user was playing demos.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He used a generic server command handler to process all inputs during demo playback.
